environment.entry: npm run dev; isolated userData; no force-renderer-accessibility

method: Formal hidden playback host in development; generated local format fixtures and synthetic navigator.mediaDevices devicechange events; not actual output hardware switching.
observability: Capture-phase audio listeners record ended/error before the core advances or clears media. Count real AudioEngine.load calls, not internal loadId, which clearSource also increments. Runtime exceptions monitored on host only during the format/recovery run. Recreated UI RPC proves host state; actual client hydration and DOM checked separately during cold start.
checks: 八种正式本地索引曲目均已准备
格式续播期间主UI已销毁
无主UI连续自然结束并推进MP3、FLAC、M4A、AAC、OGG和Opus
WMA解码失败明确停留本曲，没有静默换平台
WMA失败后可手动切到WAV正常播放
无UI设备事件防抖后只重载一次，保持断点、倍速与队列
设备恢复等待中主动暂停不会迟到起播
已暂停状态的设备事件不重载或起播
经重建UI的IPC读取后台仍保持42秒暂停断点与倍速
已监控的宿主Runtime未收到异常事件
正常退出后冷启保留WAV42秒暂停断点
冷启保留八曲队列及索引

真实UI镜像和DOM显示冷启当前曲目、断点与队列
手动播放重新读取当前本地索引并从断点继续
实际UI客户端同步手动起播后的播放态与进度

limitations: Synthetic devicechange events test the event-to-reload chain; no actual audio output device was changed
Silent generated samples do not validate audio quality, pitch preservation by ear, or every codec variant
WMA WMAv2 remains unsupported with MEDIA_ERR_4; only failure handling and manual continuation accepted
No real online account, Apple protected playback, physical media keys, Windows installer, or target-game frame-time budget
